title: Input symbol in a setup configuration
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a word of schedule symbols, and choose a base configuration on $x$, a controller phase, a valid input-head position $p$, three integer head positions, and three controller tapes. In the resulting setup configuration, the input symbol read is blank if $p=0$; otherwise it is the symbol of $x$ at zero-based index $p-1$, or blank if that index is outside $x$.
hypotheses_covered: W is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
base is a configuration on x
p is a valid input-head position
b, u, and g are integer controller-head positions
bt, ut, and gt are controller tapes
replaced:
In a setup configuration on input $x$ with input head at position
$p \in \{0,\dots,|x|+1\}$, the symbol read from the input tape is blank when $p = 0$,
and otherwise it is the $(p-1)$-st symbol of $x$ (in $0$-indexed order), which is blank
when $p - 1 \ge |x|$.
